gui.cobblemondaycare.help.caption_1: Choose a male and a female with a shared %s. The mother usually determines the offspring’s species.
gui.cobblemondaycare.help.caption_2: Press Start. Pick up the egg when it appears in the terminal.
gui.cobblemondaycare.help.caption_3: Put the egg in a nest. Right-click to check the time or collect the offspring.
gui.cobblemondaycare.help.inheritance_ca: There are 6 %s, one per stat. Give the item to one of the Pokémon. Its IV for that stat sets the offspring’s minimum.
If the offspring has a higher IV, breed with it and equip it with the matching Power Item to set the new minimum IV.
The minimum depends on the current pair and their items. Remove the Power Item and it no longer guarantees that IV.
gui.cobblemondaycare.help.attributes_cap: HP is health. The other stats affect attacks, defense or speed.
An %s is a number from 0 to 31 a Pokémon gets at birth, one per stat. Higher is better.

The %s is the lowest possible value.

%s With 23 as the HP minimum, the offspring can get 23 to 31.
